reference.capeTraversal: Cached ModelPart.render returns immediately for visible=false, before walking children. PlayerModelEmoteMixin hides BODY when Rig.expressive and SkinLimbs.bends(BODY); Rig.split recognizes chest/pelvis bones.

change.after: The early skin loop omits bending originals only for expressive rigs; after cape/wing and all worn models, it emits matching custom bent pieces through bentSkinSink with the cosmetic base material. Legacy joint-only originals remain in the normal loop.

change.normalTraversal: Normal model skin now follows the cached root definition's default HashMap-to-ordered-bake traversal, retaining cube-before-child emission. The later custom bent path keeps SkinLimbs enum order; these are different traversal sources (player-part-traversal-source.json).
change.legacyJoints: Normal originals are now hidden only for expressive rigs. Non-expressive joint-only animations keep both original normal parts and the separately submitted custom split pieces, as current Fabric source does.
change.opacity: The worn-layer opacity scope is restored before bent skin, whose tint already carries its own alpha
change.paths: Shared AvatarDrawTarget emission updates both Raster3D and NativeAvatarGeometry
change.capeVisibility: AvatarRenderer emits no cape vertices for an expressive emote with a split BODY, matching inherited cape-parent visibility, but retains an empty cape model submit (java-simple-phase-source.json). Normal skin visibility is not reused as another model's visibility receipt; worn attachments and independent wings retain their paths.
